topPRs.title: chore(release): promote Dedicated Pixel demo stack
topPRs.author: NubsCarson
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- promote the exact current `develop` tree pinned at `eda8f274986576b9a2d20c2bf8a2843bef567b67`
- include the merged personal Shared to existing Dedicated adoption/recovery stack from #29155
- include the production mobile-auth registration and Android Cloud launcher repairs already verified on the real Pixel
- keep the release candidate immutable while `develop` continues moving

## Production acceptance gate

Merge only after the exact candidate Git tree receives a successful immutable staging certification from Cloud CF Deploy. After the canonical production release:

1. verify production API health and required mobile-auth bindings without reading secret values
2. prove the signed-in Pixel switches from personal Shared to one existing owned Dedicated row without creating a third
3. prove the managed Dedicated runtime is healthy and responds through the app
4. prove chat history survives force-stop and cold relaunch

topPRs.title: release: promote Android Cloud login handoff to production
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Promote the current canonical develop@518cde18d1fb401aabfb083abcff06918413effa tree to main. It includes the Android Cloud login return-path fixes, production mobile-auth binding, clean Android Cloud build validation, main ancestry reconciliation, login translation cleanup, the release Worker heap correction, and launcher interaction/account-state hardening.

## Exact release identity

- candidate commit: 518cde18d1fb401aabfb083abcff06918413effa
- candidate tree: 8767637ca1b3aa41e2d5a6edc25e493d81c28b70
- protected staging run: https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/32956337408

## Gate

Do not merge until that exact tree has a successful immutable staging certification. After merge, run only the canonical protected production workflow and verify the public mobile config, Google return to the app, Pixel authenticated shell, and a real send/reply.

Production is currently known broken with HTTP 503 because the deployed Worker lacks ELIZA_MOBILE_APP_AUTH_ENABLED; this PR is the guarded repair path.
